flow.description: Ingestion des fichiers cars : validation, MySQL et Parquet
flow.name: ingestion-cars

properties.Schema Text:
{
  "type": "record",
  "name": "cars",
  "namespace": "tp2.nifi",
  "doc": "Schéma de validation du fichier cars.csv (dataset Auto MPG)",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "Car",          "type": "string" },
    { "name": "MPG",          "type": "double" },
    { "name": "Cylinders",    "type": "int" },
    { "name": "Displacement", "type": "double" },
    { "name": "Horsepower",   "type": ["null", "int"], "default": null },
    { "name": "Weight",       "type": "int" },
    { "name": "Acceleration", "type": "double" },
    { "name": "Model",        "type": "int" },
    { "name": "Origin",       "type": {
        "type": "enum",
        "name": "origine",
        "symbols": ["US", "Europe", "Japan"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
